questions_by_version: On the coordinate plane, consider the set of 15 lattice points \( P = \{(x, y) \in \mathbb{Z}^2 : 0 \leq x \leq 4, 0 \leq y \leq 2\} \). A subset \( S \subseteq P \) is chosen uniformly at random. Let \( R(S) \) be the smallest axis-parallel rectangle containing \( S \). The probability that \( S \neq \varnothing \) and the upper-right vertex of \( R(S) \) is \( (4, 2) \) is \( \frac{m}{n} \) in lowest terms. Find \( m+n \).
